_note: Claude picks a tier per task when it starts a Herdr worker (herdr-task.ps1 new <branch> -Tier <tier>). Ids follow Copilot's naming; an id the CLI rejects makes Copilot fall back to its default, so check the status bar of a new worker. Default effort is low (owner, 25 Nov 2026).

small.use: docs, backlog rows, one-file fixes, test-only changes, renames

standard.use: normal feature or bug fix across a few files with tests

code.use: mechanical refactors, CI / workflow / script plumbing, large test rewrites

hard.use: live-control logic (heat pump, grid, BMS, deploy gates), debugging with unclear cause
